 Allows casting this ability on a target point. The hero turns their back to it and after 0.5 seconds releases 5 waves of Quill Spray in a cone. While active, the hero is slowed by 40% and cannot turn or attack, but can cast spells in any direction.

bristleback_prickly.name: Prickly
bristleback_prickly.description: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.description: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.facet_bristleback_snot_rocket: Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.lore: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.

bristleback_quill_spray.name: Quill Spray
bristleback_quill_spray.abilitydraft_note:
Shard: Access Hairball by toggling auto-cast on Quill Spray.

Must draft Nasal Goo for it to work with Hairball.
bristleback_quill_spray.description: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
bristleback_quill_spray.lore: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.
bristleback_quill_spray.note0: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

bristleback_bristleback.name: Bristleback
bristleback_bristleback.abilitydraft_note: Quill Spray must be drafted also to release when damage threshold reached.
bristleback_bristleback.description: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
bristleback_bristleback.facet_bristleback_snot_rocket: Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.
bristleback_bristleback.lore: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
bristleback_bristleback.note0: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
bristleback_bristleback.note1: Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
bristleback_bristleback.note2: Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
bristleback_bristleback.scepter_description: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.

bristleback_warpath.name: Warpath
bristleback_warpath.description: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
bristleback_warpath.facet_bristleback_berserk: Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.
bristleback_warpath.lore: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.
bristleback_warpath.note0: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
bristleback_warpath.note2: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
bristleback_warpath.note3: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
bristleback_warpath.facet_bristleback_seeing_red: Warpath can be activated to grant bonus attack damage and movement speed for a short duration. While Seeing Red, Bristleback's vision is reduced to a narrow cone and he does not receive vision from his allies.
